articles.title: UFC 334 Press Conference: Josh Hokit Takes Over, Harrison and Nunes Clash
articles.description: UFC 334 PRESS CONFERENCE: CYRIL GANE vs JOSH HOKIT The full UFC 334 press conference from New York. UFC 334 is Saturday, November 14 at Madison Square Garden, with Gane vs. Hokit for the heavyweight title and Harrison vs. Nunes for the women's bantamweight title. Strong language throughout.
